crossRefs.note: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The…
(The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them…
All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself…
a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before…
They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now…
They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a…
There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and…
There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did…
Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

people.name: Anak
people.line: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan

translations.web: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak
translations.asv: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
